column1: excerpt|/ˈeksɜːrpt/|n.|摘录；节选|六级|argumentation-texts|a short excerpt::一小段节选;an excerpt from a novel::小说节选|The handout opens with an excerpt from a travel diary.::讲义开头是一段旅行日记的节选。|This excerpt gives a sense of the author's style.::这段节选让人对作者的风格有了初步印象。

discourse|/ˈdɪskɔːrs/|n.|话语；讨论；系统阐述|六级|argumentation-texts|public discourse::公共讨论;academic discourse::学术话语|The study traces how the phrase entered public discourse.::这项研究追溯了这个短语如何进入公共讨论。|The course compares the language of academic discourse with everyday conversation.::这门课比较学术话语和日常交谈的语言特点。

rhetoric|/ˈretərɪk/|n.|修辞；说服性的言辞；华而不实的说辞|六级|argumentation-style|the art of rhetoric::修辞的艺术;empty rhetoric::空洞的说辞|The class studies rhetoric by comparing two versions of a speech.::这门课通过比较同一篇演讲的两个版本来研究修辞。|Residents wanted a timetable for repairs instead of more rhetoric.::居民们想要一份维修时间表，不想再听空话。

denote|/dɪˈnoʊt/|v.|表示；指代；标明|六级|not-mark|denote a quantity::表示一个量;denote a category::标明一个类别|In this table, an asterisk is used to denote a missing value.::在这张表中，星号用来标记缺失值。|The letters A and B denote the two groups in the study.::字母 A 和 B 分别代表研究中的两组。

allude|/əˈluːd/|v.|暗指；间接提及|六级|argumentation-interpretation|allude to an incident::间接提到一起事件;allude to a difficulty::暗示有困难|The letter seems to allude to a dispute that took place years earlier.::这封信似乎暗指多年前发生的一场争执。|She did not name the book, but she did allude to its final scene.::她没有说出书名，却间接提到了书中的最后一幕。

deduce|/dɪˈduːs/|v.|推断；推导出|六级|argumentation-inference|deduce from the evidence::根据证据推断;deduce a result::推导出结果|We can deduce the order of events from the timestamps.::我们可以根据时间戳推断事件的先后顺序。|The students used the first two equations to deduce the final result.::学生们用前两个方程推导出最终结果。
